source: User-provided Vaydra Senki gameplay; visual reference, not a MUGEN implementation

sequences.detail: Basic extension: prepare, extend arm, retract
Skill 01: rapid three-height volleys of transformed spikes
Skill 02: forward pressing rush with white wind rings and trailing dust
Skill 03: kneel, root rises at selected ground point, curves and retracts
Skill 04: transforming rush, heavy mace and ground burst
Skill 05: giant jaw emits compact violet-black energy sphere
Larger finishing variant; kept distinct from the existing clone ultimate
